reviews.comment: One of the worst professors I've ever had. He has a habit of yelling at people when they don't meet his expectations, which is everyone all the time. His grading scale is pulled out of the ether and when the whole class does terribly on exams he blames everyone/everything but himself. His handwriting is also illegible. DO NOT TAKE THIS PROF.

he is a tough grader but very helpful in office hours. If you put in a good effort you will probably be fine. you use the textbook a lot but it wasn't a very good book. There was a ton of homework and weekly quizzes. Pretty good professor overall
reviews.ratingTags: Accessible outside class--Beware of pop quizzes--Tough grader

reviews.comment: The professor has such terrible handwriting. Sometimes, you can't tell his i's from his !'s He often times raises his voice when teaching (He thinks students will learn better that way.) Lastly, his final grades are given based on a sample distribution, so if you did well on all but one exam, your final grade could be anywhere from an A to a C.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: This is the most difficult math class I've taken so far, not because of the professor but because the material is really difficult. However, Dr. Landsberg didn't make it any easier. He makes you feel like an idiot most of the time and he does not give you much hope of passing his class. So, if you don't wanna hate math, just stay away from him.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: You can tell he really does care and wants you to learn, however he is terrible as explaining things. He was also a tough grader and often marks off points large amount of points for small things. What grade I had in the class was never clear the whole time. Office hours help a lot.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK
